texts.label: A
texts.title: Riverside Adult Education Centre — evening courses

paragraphs.text: Riverside Adult Education Centre offers evening courses for anyone aged 18 or over. This term’s courses include Spanish for beginners, digital photography and furniture repair.
Spanish for beginners runs on Tuesdays from 7 pm to 9 pm for ten weeks and costs £85. A course book is included in the price.
Digital photography takes place on Wednesday evenings. Students must bring their own camera; mobile phones are not suitable because the course covers manual settings.
Furniture repair is held in the workshop on Thursdays. Because of the equipment used, the group is limited to eight people, and students must wear strong shoes.
You can enrol online or at the centre’s office. People who receive certain benefits can apply for a 50 per cent discount.
There are no classes during the half-term holiday at the end of October. Free tea and coffee are available in the main hall before each class.
Westgate Recycling Centre is open every day except Christmas Day. From April to September it opens from 8 am to 8 pm, and from October to March from 8 am to 4 pm.
Garden waste, glass, paper and metal can be left free of charge. There is a charge of £4 per item for large furniture and £10 for each old television or computer screen.
Vans and trailers need a permit, which must be booked online at least two days before your visit. Cars do not need a permit.

When you arrive, show your permit, if you have one, to the staff at the gate. Drive to the numbered bays and put your waste into the correct containers. If you are not sure which container to use, ask a member of staff in a yellow jacket.
For safety reasons, children under 16 must stay inside the car at all times. The centre does not accept waste from businesses.

items.quote: runs on Tuesdays from 7 pm to 9 pm for ten weeks
items.prompt: Spanish for beginners: Tuesdays, 7–9 pm, for 1 ____

explanation.en: “for ten weeks” → ten weeks (or 10 weeks). £85 is the price, not the length.
explanation.kk: «for ten weeks» → ten weeks (немесе 10 weeks). £85 — ұзақтығы емес, бағасы.
explanation.ru: «for ten weeks» → ten weeks (или 10 weeks). £85 — цена, а не длительность.

items.quote: A course book is included in the price

explanation.en: “A course book is included in the price” → course book. Two words are within the limit.
explanation.kk: «A course book is included in the price» → course book. Екі сөз — шектен аспайды.
explanation.ru: «A course book is included in the price» → course book. Два слова — в пределах лимита.

items.quote: Students must bring their own camera
items.prompt: Digital photography: students need their own 3 ____

explanation.en: “must bring their own camera” → camera. “Mobile phones are not suitable”, so a phone is the wrong answer.
explanation.kk: «must bring their own camera» → camera. «Mobile phones are not suitable» — телефон дәл сәйкес келмейді.
explanation.ru: «must bring their own camera» → camera. «Mobile phones are not suitable» — телефон как раз не подходит.

items.quote: the group is limited to eight people

explanation.en: “the group is limited to eight people” → eight people (or 8). “Thursdays” and “strong shoes” are other course conditions.
explanation.kk: «the group is limited to eight people» → eight people (немесе 8). «Thursdays» мен «strong shoes» — курстың басқа шарттары.
explanation.ru: «the group is limited to eight people» → eight people (или 8). Не путайте с «Thursdays» и «strong shoes» — это другие условия курса.

items.quote: can apply for a 50 per cent discount
items.prompt: Discount for people on certain benefits: 5 ____

explanation.en: “a 50 per cent discount” → 50 per cent (or 50%). “Discount” is already in the note. “18 or over” is the age, not the discount.
explanation.kk: «a 50 per cent discount» → 50 per cent (немесе 50%). «Discount» жазбада тұр. «18 or over» — жеңілдік емес, жас.
explanation.ru: «a 50 per cent discount» → 50 per cent (или 50%). «Discount» уже стоит в заметке. «18 or over» — возраст, не скидка.

groups.title: Evening courses
groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Read Text A. Complete the notes below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.

items.quote: from October to March from 8 am to 4 pm

explanation.en: “from October to March from 8 am to 4 pm” → 4 pm. “8 pm” is summer closing time.
explanation.kk: «from October to March from 8 am to 4 pm» → 4 pm. «8 pm» — жазғы жабылу уақыты.
explanation.ru: «from October to March from 8 am to 4 pm» → 4 pm. «8 pm» — летнее время закрытия.

items.quote: £10 for each old television or computer screen
items.prompt: Television or computer screen: 7 ____ per item

explanation.en: “£10 for each old television or computer screen” → £10 (the sign is optional). The £4 in the same sentence is for furniture, the row above.
explanation.kk: «£10 for each old television or computer screen» → £10 (белгісіз де болады). Сол сөйлемдегі £4 — жиһаз ақысы, кестенің жоғарғы жолы.
explanation.ru: «£10 for each old television or computer screen» → £10 (можно без знака). £4 в том же предложении — плата за мебель, это строка таблицы выше.

items.quote: Vans and trailers need a permit

explanation.en: “Vans and trailers need a permit” → trailers, plural as in the text. Cars do not need one: “Cars do not need a permit”.
explanation.kk: «Vans and trailers need a permit» → trailers, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде. Жеңіл көлікке рұқсат керек емес: «Cars do not need a permit».
explanation.ru: «Vans and trailers need a permit» → trailers, во множественном числе, как в тексте. Для легковых машин разрешение не нужно: «Cars do not need a permit».

groups.title: Westgate Recycling Centre
groups.instruction: Questions 6–8. Read Text B. Complete the table below. Choose ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.

items.quote: show your permit, if you have one, to the staff at the gate
items.prompt: Show your permit to staff at the 9 ____

explanation.en: “show your permit … to the staff at the gate” → gate. The permit is shown at the entrance; the “bays” come afterwards, in the next step.
explanation.kk: «show your permit … to the staff at the gate» → gate. Рұқсатты кіреберісте көрсетеді; «bays» — одан кейін баратын алаңдар, схеманың келесі қадамы.
explanation.ru: «show your permit … to the staff at the gate» → gate. Разрешение показывают на въезде; «bays» — площадки, куда едут уже после этого, это следующий шаг схемы.

items.quote: ask a member of staff in a yellow jacket
items.prompt: If you are unsure, ask staff wearing a yellow 10 ____

explanation.en: “a member of staff in a yellow jacket” → jacket. “Wearing” in the chart = “in” in the text.
explanation.kk: «a member of staff in a yellow jacket» → jacket. Схемадағы «wearing» = мәтіндегі «in».
explanation.ru: «a member of staff in a yellow jacket» → jacket. «Wearing» в схеме = «in» в тексте.

steps: Show your permit to staff at the 9 ____
Put your waste into the correct containers
If you are unsure, ask staff wearing a yellow 10 ____
